Swiss Army Bench 0.0.18: projects are folders, the Project Explorer, Streamlit as its own extension, and Power Apps notebooks.

- **Projects are folders:** a project is an ordinary folder (Git, VS Code and Jupyter understand it); the app keeps
  its state in `.sab/` inside it, written only when something changed. Rows are written only when you tick Keep its
  rows, and kept out of Git. Your old `.sab` files open through **Open a .sab file…**, which imports one into a
  folder you pick.
- **The Project Explorer** is the home page: every project in your projects folder (Settings, Projects folder)
  and every one you opened elsewhere, as cards with their type, when they were opened and changed, what they hold
  and their Git branch. Sort them (last opened, name, type, last changed, created) or drag them into your own
  order; filter by type; search. A card's menu opens, copies, renames, removes from the list or deletes (to the
  trash, after you type its name).
- **What kind of project?** Each project type explained in plain words with an example, on the page and in New
  project: Analysis, Streamlit app, and each installed extension's own (Accounting workbook, Power Apps code app).
- **Streamlit is its own extension, preinstalled:** new installs and updates keep it; the Extensions page can
  remove it, and the app is then the Analysis base. Updating from 0.0.17 adds it back on the first start (the app
  restarts once).
- **Power Apps, phase 2:** a code app's data notebook with TypeScript and SQL cells on one DuckDB (Deno), Dataverse
  tables as grids, `src/shared/data.ts` exported for the app (types and small fixed results; never DuckDB, which a
  code app's security policy blocks), TSX cells previewed, and the code app's pages: `src/pages/<Page>/` with
  New page, and only the files you edit listed.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.18), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
